name: The Purifier
description: A mid-game Hunt for the Bismarck. An ancient planet destroyer and its escort sleep at a hidden station in a remote gas cloud. When an explorer wakes them, it destroys the colonies of the races it was told to hunt (preprogrammed, or the waker chooses), one world at a time, then jumps away into deep space. Nobody controls it. Hunt it from its last known position, wound its hyperdrive, find its repair station: it is helpless while docked.
